The '''Sabat''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Visual Guide" /> The Sabat had [[Color|blue]],<ref name="Yoda 4" /> [[Color|pink]],<ref name="Visual Guide" /> or tan<ref name="Yoda 4" /> colored skin, large foreheads and flattened heads. [[Leevan Tenza]], a member of [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]], was a Sabat.<ref name="Visual Guide" /> [[Gelan Yees]] was a Sabat member of the [[Cloud-Riders]].<ref name="Solo" /> At least one Sabat was a [[Jedi Initiate]] during the [[Republic Era]].<ref name="Yoda 4" />
